responsibility: This file implements GCC’s general RTL printing and pretty-printing support for both generator programs and the compiler proper. It defines rtx_writer, detailed operand-format printing, compact and simplified dump modes, handling of MEM annotations, notes, insn pretty-printers, slim dump helpers, DOT graph labels, and optional reuse_rtx syntax through rtx_reuse_manager to preserve pointer-identity-sensitive shared RTX nodes in round-trippable dumps. It is the core formatting engine behind RTL debugging output and serialized dumps.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL dump/pretty-print machinery declared in print-rtl.h, including formatting of insns and operands, slim dumps, graph labels, and reuse_rtx-aware serialization logic.
